digest.component_or_area: close status event metadata and gate-state tracking
propositions: A reader cannot distinguish a close with a lost completion signature from one closed with the gate disabled, because gate state is read and discarded during close and only ephemeral payload loss is reported

The completion_expectation enum must record eight distinct close paths (required, disposition, gate_off, gate_unreadable, force_bypassed, local_source, not_certifiable, not_applicable) on the *->closed STATUS event in the same locked write as the close

The expectation is computed from gate state (tri-state GateState, not bool) and close path semantics, with gate state resolving first so forced closes under disabled/unreadable configs record the gate condition, not force_bypassed

A later reader combining durable expectation with durable attestation can distinguish closed-and-signed (required + attestation) from closed-with-signature-lost (required, no attestation) from closed-with-gate-off (gate_off) by reading reduced state only
The idea→closed transition must explicitly set expectation to not_applicable (a REJECT/DROP is not a completion) since that path bypasses _completion_precheck entirely
The field is additive, present-only, backward-compatible with historical events lacking the key (which reduce to state with the key absent, never guessed)
